reason: Named lab and a batch report I can check against the box is the first time a magnesium offer answers what I always look for. The empty-box guarantee and the $24.99 launch box make it a low-risk try, even though my drawer is already full.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? And I would want to open the actual lab report and see the dose matches before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch was missing, not matching the batch number, or showed less than 200 mg elemental magnesium, I would not buy.
